column13: Annual targets were 50, 100 and 150. The 2024 result is 217% of target. Baseline taken as zero.

column13: No target. No result in 2023 or 2024.

column13: Child Protection Committees' Guide and the Comprehensive Post Abortion Care guidelines (2024).

column3: Children aged 12 to 23 months fully immunised (DTP3)
column13: Baseline 70% (2021). The 95% target is for 2026 and the evaluation judged it unlikely to be met. No 2024 result.

column3: People diagnosed with HIV who are on treatment
column13: No target. The next figure comes from the Botswana AIDS Impact Survey, held every five years.

column13: 2024 includes the costed immunisation strategy 2024-2029 and the laboratory, oral health and prison health policies.

column13: No target. The index has stayed at 15. The public health emergency operations centre still has no site.

column3: Schools implementing the inclusive education policy
column13: No target and no result in any year.

column13: Annual target was about 195,000 (194,459 in 2023). Results are 271% and 289% of target. Baseline taken as zero.

column13: No target and no result in any year.
